offering_description.value: Develops AI-powered voice assistants, speech recognition, text-to-speech and generative AI software for vehicles. Sells embedded and cloud-connected software to automakers and their suppliers, who integrate it into cars.

primary_products.value: in-car voice assistant software; speech recognition and text-to-speech software; generative AI in-car assistant platform; cloud-connected automotive AI services

primary_services.value: software customization and integration; connected cloud services; professional engineering services

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive OEMs and tier-1 suppliers, some other device makers

end_markets.value: automotive; commercial vehicles; two-wheelers; smart devices

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: per-vehicle royalties on embedded software shipped in cars; project or contract: upfront license and professional services fees for customization; subscription: connected cloud services and updates billed to automakers
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; project or contract; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: builds AI voice software sold to automakers and suppliers for embedding in vehicles

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia including Japan, China and India

specialization.value: related lines: voice assistants, speech recognition, text-to-speech and generative AI for vehicles

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with automotive OEMs; partners / resellers: tier-1 suppliers that integrate its software

regulatory_exposure.value: low: data privacy rules such as GDPR and automotive software standards apply, but no licence is needed
